After.description: What a hold's `after` waits for: another task to end, or a Linear issue to close.

Hold.description:
Why a task is held, and the conditions that release it once all of them hold. With none, a
person does.

after.description:
Other tasks' ids, or Linear issues such as `ENG-7`: until each task ends and each issue is
Done or Canceled. One value or a list.

blockers.description: Until the task's Linear issue has no open blocker.

if_closed.description: What a pull request closed without a merge does: `release`, `drop` or `ask`, the default.

merge.description:
Pull requests, `owner/name#42` or `42` in the task's repository: until each merges. One
value or a list.

reason.description: Why the task waits, shown to a person.

until.description: An RFC 3339 instant, or a duration such as `2 hours` after the hold.

Intervention.description: Who answers a task's asks. Unset, every ask goes to a person.

oneOf.description:
A person approves the plan: a grading step's result waits for an answer before the task
moves on, even for a green grade.

The trigger's `lead` answers asks in the person's place, except an ask whose answer lets an
irreversible step run and an ask whose answer runs a command.

OneOrMany_After.description: One value, or a list of them; null reads as none, as the single values it replaced did.

OneOrMany_string.description: One value, or a list of them; null reads as none, as the single values it replaced did.

Pick.description: A choice a person makes with `priory report pick`.

applied.description: What the workflow did with the choice.

chosen.description: The person's choice. Only `priory report pick` sets it: a write keeps the stored one.

id.description: Unique in the report, such as 2026-11-20_sentry_fnd-2409.

requests.description: Options that request a task instead of waking the report's task, by option.

Request.description: A task request: `priory request`'s flags, or a report pick option's request.

intervention.description: Who answers the task's asks; `triggers/cli.toml`'s when unset.

key.description: The task's key, which Priory prefixes with `cli:`.

comments.description:
Empty in a write: Priory fills it with the row's comment threads, oldest first. A row
needs an `id` to take comments.

key.description: An issue or pull request key, such as FND-2409.

meta.description: A second line, such as 41 events since 18:00.

owner.description: Who the row waits on, such as "on Max".

state.description: A task state for the row's tile.

count.description: The number a front end shows beside the title, when it is not the number of rows.

description:
A report a workflow writes for its task: ordered sections of rows. The latest one per task is
kept, with a revision that each write and each pick raises.

date.description: The day the report is for, such as 2026-11-20.

greeting.description: The line the report opens with.

sections.description: The sections, in the order a front end draws them.

since.description: The RFC 3339 instant the report covers changes from.

title: Report
